contents: Second Night: All Problems Are Interpersonal Relationship Problems
Third Night: Discard Other People's Tasks
Fourth Night: Where the Center of the World Is
Fifth Night: To Live in Earnest in the Here and Now

audiences: People exhausted by approval-seeking or attempts to manage other people's reactions
Readers who want an accessible introduction to Kishimi and Koga's interpretation of Adlerian psychology
People willing to test a strong agency-first philosophy while rejecting its unsafe claims about trauma
Readers interested in boundaries, contribution, inferiority, relationships, freedom, and present-focused action

sources.title: The Courage to be Disliked
sources.author_or_publisher: Louie Giray; Selçuk University Journal of Faculty of Letters
sources.supports: Whole-book summary, five-night concepts, praise for accessibility and practical relevance, and criticism of the youth's simplistic characterization and excessive subparts.
sources.limitations: Short, strongly favourable academic book review rather than a psychological evidence audit.

sources.title: The Courage to Be Disliked
sources.supports: Large reader aggregate and recurring reactions to the ideas, dialogue, accessibility, provocation, repetition, and trauma claim.
sources.limitations: Self-selected ratings and reviews, merged editions, no expertise check, and popularity is excluded from the content rating.

sources.title: Reviews — The Courage To Be Disliked
sources.supports: Reader division over the dialogue, practical reframes, present-focus ending, victim-blaming risk, gender assumptions, and the philosopher's staged victory.
sources.limitations: Self-selected community responses; examples show recurring themes but do not establish population prevalence.

sources.title: What the self-help book The Courage to Be Disliked gets right and wrong
sources.supports: Philosophy-informed criticism of trauma denial, weak treatment of power structures, vague delivery, and praise for task separation and limits of control.
sources.limitations: Personal critical essay rather than peer-reviewed clinical analysis.

sources.title: PTSD History and Overview
sources.author_or_publisher: US Department of Veterans Affairs, National Center for PTSD
sources.supports: Clinical counterevidence: traumatic exposure is required for PTSD, responses vary through risk, resilience, appraisal, and context, and severe events affect nearly everyone even though not everyone develops PTSD.
sources.limitations: Clinical overview of PTSD, not a review of every way adverse experience affects later behaviour.

sources.title: Evidence-Based Individual Psychology Practice: Adlerian Pattern Focused Therapy
sources.supports: Current Adlerian field's effort to standardize treatment and its acknowledgement that clinical evidence remains limited across populations, cultures, and long-term outcomes.
sources.limitations: Narrative review from within the Adlerian practice literature, not a systematic meta-analysis of this book's claims.

sources.title: A Meta-Analytic Review of Experiments Examining the Effects of Extrinsic Rewards on Intrinsic Motivation
sources.author_or_publisher: Edward Deci, Richard Koestner, and Richard Ryan; Psychological Bulletin
sources.supports: Nuanced countercheck of the book's blanket rejection of praise and rewards: effects differ by reward type and context, while positive feedback can enhance interest.
sources.limitations: Meta-analysis concerns intrinsic motivation, not the book's wider moral case against vertical relationships.

sources.title: Social Relationships and Mortality Risk: A Meta-analytic Review
sources.author_or_publisher: Julianne Holt-Lunstad, Timothy Smith, and J. Bradley Layton; PLOS Medicine
sources.supports: Broad empirical support for the importance of social integration and relationships while not supporting the universal claim that every problem is interpersonal.
sources.limitations: Observational mortality meta-analysis; it does not validate Adlerian community feeling or prove that social connection causes every measured outcome.

workflow.coverage_notes: Official publisher records, the original detailed contents, an English publisher reading guide, a whole-book scholarly review, specialist evidence, independent criticism, and large reader sources cover all five nights and test the strongest claims. No lawfully accessible complete text was used.
